title: 第25章 明目张胆作弊第26章 发难
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 李轩速度极快，只是几步就来到了登天梯前，并且踏上了第一阶。
几乎就在他踏上第一阶的刹那，一股无形的风暴陡然席卷而来，狠狠的拍打在他的身上。
李轩眼眸中闪过一抹异色，却是并没有受到多大影响，抬起脚步就欲迈上第二阶。
但就在这时，高台上的鲁鸣礼心中冷哼一声，精神力微微波动。
霎时间，李轩只感觉一股恐怖无比的威压落在自己身上，直接就令得他那抬起的右腿，僵在了半空之中。
看到这一幕，现场无数人都是有些懵比，很是莫名其妙。
“他在做什么，怎么突然就不动了？”
“不知道啊，莫非是他意志力不过关，承受不住压力？”
“拉倒吧，那可是能够逆伐先天境三重的狠人，要是他都不过关，还有谁能过关？”
“卧槽，我知道了，那家伙肯定是在装逼。”
由于李轩的名气，现场认识或者知道他的人自然不少。
当看到他这副动作时，所有人都是忍不住哗然了起来。
“玛德，这些个不要脸的老狗。”
与此同时，李轩也是在心中暗骂一句，转而那抬起的右脚落下，稳稳落在了第二阶上。
鲁鸣礼看到这一幕，眼中先是闪过一丝讶异，紧接着便是掠过了一道寒光。
竟然能够抗住他的精神力威压，果真是有着几分本事。
他冷哼一声，精神力波动稍微剧烈了一些，继续朝着李轩压去。
鲁鸣礼可是收了林家不少好处，这拿了钱自然是得办事的。
否则，以后还怎么赚外快，谁还敢找他办事？
林长恨看到李轩登上第二阶，脸色微变，但很快就恢复了正常。
倒是林长颓有些没忍住，小声的恨恨道：“他怎么没有被淘汰出去？难道鲁长老没有出手？”
“闭嘴！”
林长恨听到这话，立即低声呵斥一句，旋即才说道：“你是蠢货吗？以那李轩的实力，如果在第一阶就被扫出去，岂不是会惹人怀疑？”
林长颓了然，“哦，原来是这样啊。”
同一时刻。
李轩已经踏上第二阶。
几乎就在他踏上第二阶的刹那，一股更为恐怖的风暴席卷而来，伴随而来的还有一股更为强大的精神力威压。
这双重风暴，就宛若是数座神山压在他的身上，威力比起第一阶何止强了十倍？
“尼玛，这是明目张胆在作弊啊。”
李轩心中破口大骂，眼神也是愈发的冷冽。
他怒哼一声，肉身力量疯狂爆发，体内灵气暴走，精神力涌动，开始竭力对抗起了那股威压。
他猛地抬腿，落下，稳稳落在了第三阶之上。
“什么？”
鲁鸣礼看到这一幕，有些懵逼。
简直都不敢相信自己的眼睛！
区区一个炼气境蝼蚁，竟然挡住了自己的精神力威压，这怎么可能呢？
哪怕他只是稍微动用了一些精神力，并没有那么明显，也绝对不是区区一个炼气境蝼蚁可以挡住的吧？
“不对劲，他不是炼气，而是先天！”
鲁鸣礼眼神微眯。
另外一侧。
林长恨看到李轩踏上第三阶，也终于是无法再淡定了。
content_en:
Li Xuan was extremely fast. He arrived at the ladder in just a few steps and stepped onto the first step.
Almost the moment he stepped onto the first step, an invisible storm suddenly swept over and slapped him hard.
A strange color flashed in Li Xuan's eyes, but he was not greatly affected. He raised his steps to step up to the second level.
"Hmph."
But at this moment, Lu Mingli on the high platform snorted coldly in his heart, and his mental power fluctuated slightly.
In an instant, Li Xuan felt a terrifying coercion fall on him, causing his raised right leg to freeze in mid-air.
Seeing this scene, countless people at the scene were a little confused and baffled.
"What is he doing? Why does he suddenly stop moving?"
"I don't know. Could it be that he has insufficient willpower and can't bear the pressure?"
"Pull him down, he is a ruthless person who can defeat the third level of Xiantian Realm. If he can't pass, who else can pass?"
"Fuck, I know, that guy must be showing off."
Due to Li Xuan's fame, there are naturally many people who know or know him at the scene.
When they saw his action, everyone couldn't help but burst into an uproar.
"Mad, these shameless old dogs."
At the same time, Li Xuan also cursed secretly in his heart, then lowered his raised right foot, landing firmly on the second step.
"Huh?"
Seeing this scene, Lu Mingli's eyes first flashed with surprise, and then a cold light flashed across his eyes.
To be able to withstand his mental pressure, he really has some ability.
He snorted coldly, his mental power fluctuated a little more violently, and he continued to press towards Li Xuan.
Lu Mingli received a lot of benefits from the Lin family, so he naturally had to do things with the money.
Otherwise, how can I make extra money in the future? Who would dare to ask him for help?
When Lin Changhen saw Li Xuan ascending to the second level, his expression changed slightly, but he soon returned to normal.
However, Lin Changwan couldn't hold it back and said in a low voice, "How come he wasn't eliminated? Didn't Elder Lu take action?"
"Shut up!"
When Lin Changhen heard this, he immediately scolded him in a low voice, and then said: "Are you a fool? With Li Xuan's strength, if he was swept out at the first level, wouldn't it arouse suspicion?"
Lin Chang was stunned, "Oh, so that's it."
same moment.
Li Xuan has already stepped onto the second level.
Almost the moment he stepped onto the second level, an even more terrifying storm swept over, along with an even more powerful mental pressure.
This double storm was like several sacred mountains pressing down on him. It was more than ten times more powerful than the first level?
"Nima, this is blatant cheating."
Li Xuan cursed loudly in his heart, and his eyes became colder and colder.
He roared angrily, his physical strength exploded wildly, the spiritual energy in his body surged, and his spiritual power surged, and he began to fight against the pressure with all his strength.
He suddenly raised his leg and dropped it, landing firmly on the third step.
"What?"
Lu Mingli was a little confused when he saw this scene.
I couldn’t believe my eyes!
A mere ant in the Qi Refining Realm actually blocked the pressure of his own mental power. How is this possible?
Even if he only used a little bit of mental power and it wasn't that obvious, he definitely couldn't be blocked by a mere Qi Refining Realm ant, right?
"Something's wrong, he's not refining qi, but innate!"
Lu Mingli's eyes narrowed slightly.
The other side.
When Lin Changhen saw Li Xuan stepping onto the third level, he could no longer remain calm.
